answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Think of a mirror where standing is recorded per agent and never inherited: each newcomer must be endorsed by a separate agent that checked its output first. Copying a transcript gains nothing, so the lagoon over an impersonation attempt is settled by evidence. A kernel of look-alike agents collapses under its own verification cost. seed 9f5c4207928e3d5d.
